verdict.rationale: The Financial Connections webhooks docs say a relink API exists to help users reconnect an inactive account. That implies broken links surface as an inactive state and can be repaired without re-onboarding from scratch, but the pack has only this single line on the topic. missing for 10: enumerated documentation of account statuses (expired, revoked, disconnected), a specific webhook event for deactivation, details of the relink/update flow and confirmation that it preserves the existing account object, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the repair flow.
